description: A woman in a dark navy tailored coat, long skirt, gloves and a wide-brimmed dark hat sits sideways on a green leather bench in a dark wood-paneled legislative-style chamber, one gloved hand on a carved wooden rail. Dark-suited, mustached men in early 1900s dress sit on benches around her. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no border or frame. No legible letters or numbers; a tiny multicolored mark sits in the bottom-right corner.
